bullets.text: Illusions now apply most on-hit item effects, at a default 20% Item Potency.
src: Illusions have a default Item Potency of 20% and can now apply most item on hit effects

bullets.text: Hero attacks default to 100% Item Potency.
src: The default Item Potency value for an attack is 100%

bullets.text: A Tier 4 Evolved Enchantment gives +20% Item Potency.
src: Any hero attacking with a Tier 4 Evolved Enchantment has +20% Item Potency, so if they have a Desolator the attack would reduce armor by 7.2

bullets.text: Heroes, Roshan, towers and the fountain deal 1 full pip per attack.
src: Attacks from heroes, Roshan, towers, and the fountain deal 1 full pip per attack

bullets.text: Illusions and creeps deal 1/4 pip per attack.
src: Attacks from illusions and creeps deal 1/4 pip per attack

bullets.text: Fragile units take two pips from melee heroes.
src: Some units have a Fragile debuff that causes them to take two pips of damage from melee heroes

bullets.text: Base hero Health goes from 120 to 200.
src: Base hero Health increased from 120 to 200

bullets.text: Health per point of Strength drops from 22 to 20.
src: Health gained per point of Strength decreased from 22 to 20

bullets.text: Everyone passively gets 50 experience per minute after the horn.
src: All heroes now passively receive 50 experience per minute after the starting horn
Initial spawn time decreased from 20:00 to 15:00

bullets.text: Tormentor's Unyielding Shield barrier goes from 3000 to 4000.
src: Unyielding Shield: Base barrier increased from 3000 to 4000

bullets.text: Roshan's respawn timer drops 1 minute per defeat, down to 5 minutes.
src: Base respawn timer now decreases by 1 minute every time Roshan is defeated, to a minimum of 5 minutes
Number of item tiers decreased from 5 to 4

bullets.text: Each tier is split into pools, and 1 Artifact is chosen per pool.
src: Each tier is now separated into multiple pools of Artifacts, and 1 Artifact is chosen per pool

bullets.text: Madstone cost for Tier 4 items goes from 10 to 14.
src: Madstone cost for Tier 4 items increased from 10 to 14

cards.title: Map: Twin Gates, towers, Dire fountain

bullets.text: Twin Gates move to the top and bottom rim of the map.
src: Twin Gates moved to the top and bottom rim of the map, where small flooded camps used to be

bullets.text: Tier 1 towers move roughly 350 units from the Radiant base, Tier 2 roughly 260.
src: Moved Radiant and Dire Tier 2 tower roughly 260 units away from Radiant base and Radiant and Dire Tier 1 towers roughly 350 units away from Radiant base

bullets.text: The Dire fountain moves ~300 units closer to the Dire Ancient.
src: Dire fountain moved ~300 units closer to the Dire Ancient
